episode.tagline: For almost 80 years, one book has been the go-to book for understanding economics — and the world. Henry Hazlitt wrote that book.
episode.about: In this episode, Amit and Ajay discuss Economics in One Lesson by Henry Hazlitt — a book you must read if you want to understand the subject! Pick it up here: https://amzn.in/d/02K9l4h or here (free pdf): https://tinyurl.com/aauetmk3
